title: Ancient Amber
description: My weird material mod with a bunch of random things yay
body:
So this is my silly material mod. Every once in a while I will make a new update every update will add a new type of material, now im probaly not going to do a lot of ore based materials like the namesake of this mod Amber you get from finding a gold oak tree. I will not make any updates that are not the main new material so a texture update for a first update item wont happen till second update. Everytime I make a update I will include a box with all features. Ok anyway You will want to use a mod like JEI or REI or EMI and so on and so forth to see recipes. here is where I will put the list of materials (dont worry this will expand over time) and if a update comes out that changes a old feature I will update the page about it also every update will have 2 random things that are related by like color or something.


<details>
<summary>Update 1</summary>
Find a gold oak tree in a dark oak forest biome(note these trees are very rare)
some of the leaves will have sap in them if you right click the leaves with a bottle you will
get a bottle of sap. With 9 bottles of sap you can craft a block of sap. by smelting said block of sap by smelting said block of sap you will get a block of crystilized sap mine this to get 4 crystilized sap and smelting the crystilized sap gets you amber. (Note: I will eventually change it so you have to leave the block of sap out in the sun instead of just smelting it) you can also make crystilized sap bricks 

So with amber you can craft the amber longsword, amber greataxe, amber pickaxe, and amber bow 

for the 2 random things I added cheese which you obtain by crafting a bucket of milk and a bottle to get a bottle of milk if you brew the bottle of milk you get melty cheese which you can make into cheese a pretty good food source. I also added a skull mask which you can craft with 2 string and a skeleton skull. thats pretty much it for update 1 but more will come in the future 


</details>
